description: Calculate the earliest permissible start date for a Section 13 (Form 4A) rent increase for an assured periodic tenancy in England, and the latest date to serve the notice. Use when a UK landlord asks about raising rent, Section 13 notice periods, Form 4A timing, or when a rent increase can take effect. England only; general guidance, not legal advice; does not create or serve a notice.

country.description: Country of the tenancy (for example england, scotland, wales). Defaults to england.

last_rent_increase_date.description: The date the rent last took effect after an increase (YYYY-MM-DD), if it has been increased before.

payment_frequency.description: How often rent is paid under the tenancy.

proposed_start_date.description: Optional date the landlord has in mind for the increase (YYYY-MM-DD).

rent_due_date.description: A date rent is currently due (YYYY-MM-DD), used to anchor the rent period. Any recent or upcoming due date works.

tenancy_type.description: Type of tenancy, for example assured_periodic or fixed_term. Defaults to assured_periodic.

name: calculate_notice_dates
title: Calculate Section 13 notice dates
